h1: The 7 Best Small Handheld Vacuums of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Small Handheld Vacuums: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: seven compact cordless handheld vacuums compared on power, storage size, pet hair tools and included accessories.
summary: The Shark WANDVAC is the best small handheld here, thanks to a slim body that stores almost anywhere. The BLACK+DECKER 20V Dustbuster is the choice if you want a stated power class. Pet owners should compare the Bissell Pet Hair Eraser with the BLACK+DECKER Furbuster, and the 8V Dustbuster covers light crumbs cheaply.
intro: A handheld vacuum earns its place by being within arm's reach. The ones that fail are not weak, they are inconvenient: tucked in a closet, battery flat, forgotten until the crumbs have spread. So this ranking starts with storage and moves on to power, tools and pet hair.

We ranked seven small cordless handhelds using stated features and product listings, with no claim of home trials. Size and storage count most, followed by the power class named in each listing, included tools and how well the design deals with pet hair. Prices are shown as buckets, and gaps in published specs are flagged rather than guessed.

products.name: Shark WANDVAC Cordless Hand Vac, Black, WV201BK
products.verdict: A slim cordless hand vac from a major brand that stores almost anywhere.
products.description:
The Shark WANDVAC is a compact cordless hand vacuum with a slim storage profile, sold under a household name. It sits in the $50 to $100 bucket. Its listing leans on the shape of the body and the cordless design rather than on a spec sheet.

It leads because storage footprint decides whether a handheld gets used, and this one is the slimmest of the group. The BLACK+DECKER 20V states a power class, which the Shark listing does not, but the Dustbuster is bulkier on a shelf. A tool that lives in an open drawer beats a stronger one that stays in a cupboard.

Buy it for quick cleanups in a small home. The caveat is the missing voltage: if you want a confirmed power figure, move to the next pick.
products.idealFor: Small homes where storage space is limited.
products.skipIf: You want a stated voltage or pet tools.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER Dustbuster 20V Hand Vacuum Cordless Rechargeable
products.verdict: A 20V compact Dustbuster with an extendible crevice tool.
products.description:
The BLACK+DECKER Dustbuster 20V is a cordless rechargeable hand vacuum that names its power class, 20V, and adds an extendible crevice tool in a compact body. It falls in the $50 to $100 bucket.

Second place is a close call. The listing puts a concrete number on suction power, which is a real step up from the 8V model at the bottom of the list, but it is bulkier than the Shark WANDVAC and therefore less likely to sit somewhere handy. The extendible crevice tool is a nice touch for car seats and tight corners.

Buy it if you want confirmed power without going to a full stick vacuum. Skip it if storage space is your first concern, because a slimmer body will get used more often.
products.idealFor: People who want stated power in a small tool.
products.skipIf: Storage space is the first concern.

products.name: Black+Decker Dustbuster AdvancedClean Handheld Vacuum Cordless, Compact Home and Car Vacuum
products.verdict: A compact Dustbuster with a charging station and crevice tool.
products.description:
The Black+Decker Dustbuster AdvancedClean is a compact cordless hand vacuum for home and car. A crevice tool and a charging station come in the box, and it costs $25 to $50.

Third place goes to it because the included station keeps it topped up where it is stored, a quiet advantage that makes it more reliable on a busy morning. The low price helps too. What it lacks is a stated voltage, which leaves its suction a question mark next to the 20V model above.

Buy it for a household that wants accessories and a dock without spending more. Skip it if you want a named power class. The basic design is more practical than exciting, but it covers everyday spills well.
products.idealFor: People who want accessories with a wall-ready dock.

products.name: Bissell Pet Hair Eraser Cordless Hand Vacuum, Home, Auto & Pet, 2390A
products.verdict: A compact cordless vac built around pet hair removal from a known brand.
products.description:
Bissell's Pet Hair Eraser is a compact cordless hand vacuum with a design aimed at pet hair on furniture, stairs and in the car. It is branded around its Pet Hair Eraser technology and sits in the $50 to $100 bucket.

Fourth place reflects its focus. The listing offers few specs beyond the pet theme, and the BLACK+DECKER Furbuster below adds a motorized brush that Bissell lacks. Against the general-purpose Dustbusters above, though, it is a better fit when fur is the main mess.

Buy it if you own pets and trust the Bissell name. Skip it if you want a motorized pet brush, in which case the Furbuster is the stronger pick. Check what attachments ship in the box, because the listing is brief.
products.idealFor: Pet owners wanting a branded compact vac.
products.skipIf: You want a motorized pet brush.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER Dustbuster Furbuster Pet Hair Vacuum with Motorized Pet Hair Brush
products.verdict: A rechargeable handheld with a motorized brush for stubborn pet hair.
products.description:
The BLACK+DECKER Furbuster is a compact rechargeable Dustbuster with a motorized pet hair brush, intended for home and car use, priced from $50 to $100.

Rank five is down to the bulk that comes with the brush works against it. For stubborn fur on upholstery, the spinning brush does what suction alone cannot, but the slimmer picks above are easier to store and grab. It also focuses so tightly on pet messes that it is less useful for general crumbs.

Buy it for a home with shedding dogs or cats and couches that collect hair. Skip it if you want the slimmest possible tool, because the Shark WANDVAC takes much less space. Expect the brush to add some weight in your hand.
products.skipIf: You want the slimmest possible tool.

products.name: Shark Cyclone PET Handheld Vacuum, Navy Blue/Grey, CH701
products.verdict: A compact Shark with cyclone technology and a pet focus.
products.description:
The Shark Cyclone PET is a compact handheld that uses cyclone technology, with a pet focus and the Shark name. It lives in the $50 to $100 bucket, but the listing says little beyond that.

It ranks sixth because thin specifications leave too much unknown. Next to the WANDVAC, which wins on slimness, this model is bulkier and offers no stated voltage or tools. It is best understood as another way into the Shark brand for pet households.

Buy it if you trust Shark and want a pet-friendly compact vacuum. Skip it if you want a stated voltage or a list of tools, because the BLACK+DECKER 20V and Furbuster publish more. Check the box contents before ordering.
products.idealFor: Shark fans wanting a compact pet vac.
products.skipIf: You want a stated voltage or tools.

products.name: BLACK+DECKER Dustbuster Handheld Vacuum, 8V Cordless, Hand Vacuum for Quick Cleanup
products.verdict: An 8V Dustbuster sized for quick, light messes, with a washable filter.
products.description:
The BLACK+DECKER Dustbuster 8V is a compact cordless vacuum built for quick cleanups, with a washable filter. It sits in the $25 to $50 bucket, making it the cheapest pick.

It ranks last because 8V is the lowest power class here, well behind the 20V Dustbuster. For crumbs, spilled cereal and desk debris, that is enough, and a washable filter keeps running costs low. Anything heavier, such as ground-in dirt or pet hair, will expose its limits.

Buy it as a light-duty tool for a kitchen counter or office desk. Skip it if you need stronger suction, since the 20V model costs only a little more and handles a wider range of mess.

whatMatters.detail: A handheld that stores slimly gets used, while a bulky one gets forgotten. A wall mount, dock or slim body keeps it reachable. This matters more than suction for daily crumbs. Look for words like slim, compact or wall mount in the title or bullets, and think about where the vacuum will actually live.

Voltage is a rough power class: the 20V Dustbuster is stronger than the 8V one. It matters because a small tool with weak suction leaves dirt behind. Look for the voltage figure in the title. If a listing does not state it, as with the Shark WANDVAC, treat power as unconfirmed.

A crevice tool is a narrow nozzle that reaches car seats, window tracks and corners where the main opening cannot go. It makes a small vacuum far more useful. Check the included accessories on the listing. The BLACK+DECKER 20V Dustbuster lists an extendible one, which reaches deeper than a fixed tip.

A motorized brush has a spinning head that lifts hair from upholstery better than suction alone. Pet owners notice the difference on couches and car seats. Look for motorized brush in the title. The BLACK+DECKER Furbuster is the only one in this ranking that names one.

A washable filter can be rinsed and reused instead of replaced, which saves money over time. It also keeps suction up if you maintain it. Look for washable in the listing. The 8V Dustbuster names one. Always dry a washed filter completely before putting it back, since a damp filter can smell.

faq.a: They suit light messes such as crumbs, spills and car seats. Power varies by class, so the 20V BLACK+DECKER Dustbuster is stronger than its 8V sibling. None replaces a full vacuum.
Buying on power alone. A strong handheld that is awkward to reach stays in the cupboard, while a slim one like the Shark WANDVAC gets used every day for small spills.

faq.q: Is the 20V Dustbuster worth it over the 8V?
faq.a: For heavier messes, yes. The 20V model has more suction and an extendible crevice tool. For crumbs on a desk or counter, the cheaper 8V Dustbuster is enough and costs less.

faq.q: How do I look after the filter?
faq.a: Tap the dust out regularly. If the filter is washable, as on the 8V Dustbuster, rinse it and let it dry completely before reuse. Check each manual for the exact steps.

faq.q: Can I use these in a car?
faq.a: Several list car use, including the Black+Decker AdvancedClean and the Furbuster. A crevice tool helps with seats and tight corners, so prefer a model that includes one.

faq.q: Will they pick up pet hair?
faq.a: The BLACK+DECKER Furbuster has a motorized brush for pet hair, which grabs fur better than suction alone. The Bissell Pet Hair Eraser targets pet hair too, while the others rely on suction.

finalTake: Buy the Shark WANDVAC if you want a handheld you will actually pick up. Choose the BLACK+DECKER 20V when confirmed power matters more than storage, and the Furbuster for homes with shedding pets. The 8V Dustbuster is fine for crumbs and desks, but anyone with heavier messes should step up a class.
